change: Edited and normalized detail surfaces use bounded-row lossless ARGB files instead of PNG compression/decompression. Same-mode pan reuses in-progress preparation; comparison-mode changes cancel obsolete preparation.

measurement.reference: Copied legacy full-render PNG preparation/fit pipeline; not a baseline APK or physical phone comparison.

build.note: Windows PowerShell native build reached all 12 native library outputs, then stalled at metadata finalization; a temporary copy of the app build script reused those byte-identical existing outputs. APK Java/dex/resources/alignment and v2/v3 signature checks succeeded. The missing Windows PowerShell Get-FileHash at final sidecar generation was replaced by Node SHA-256; repository build scripts were not changed.

tradeoff: Private transient ARGB surfaces take 4 bytes/pixel plus a 16-byte header and are removed when the detail source closes. Screen-fit point sampling can differ from the previous PNG sampling; 100%/200% use unsampled original rendered pixels.
